pairs: and beautiful praise shall be for our God.
He will gather together the dispersed of Israel.
He heals the contrite of heart,
and he binds up their sorrows.
He numbers the multitude of the stars,
and he calls them all by their names.
et sapientiæ ejus non est numerus.
And of his wisdom, there is no number.
The Lord lifts up the meek,
humilians autem peccatores usque ad terram.
but he brings down the sinner, even to the ground.
Sing before the Lord with confession.
Play psalms to our God on a stringed instrument.
and he prepares rain for the earth.
He produces grass on the mountains
and herbs for the service of men.
He gives their food to beasts of burden
and to young ravens that call upon him.
Non in fortitudine equi voluntatem habebit,
He will not have good will for the strength of the horse,
nec in tibiis viri beneplacitum erit ei.
nor will he be well pleased with the legs of a man.
Beneplacitum est Domino super timentes eum,
The Lord is well pleased with those who fear him
et in eis qui sperant super misericordia ejus.
and with those who hope in his mercy.
